svg.title: Harinand AS — product engineer
svg.desc: Product engineer · B.Tech AI & ML, class of 2027. I take half-formed ideas and push them until they have a URL. Cycles through live projects: Campus Hub, Adukala.AI, PG Finder, MedReminder, BunkerMe.

g.text: OPEN TO WORK · KOCHI, KERALA, INDIA
